title: SenseFOG: subthalamic LFP (Medtronic Percept), EEG/EMG and IMU kinematics during sitting, standing, walking, stopping and freezing of gait in Parkinson's disease
description: This dataset contains multimodal recordings from 12 patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease and bilateral subthalamic deep brain stimulation (Medtronic Percept PC). Recordings were made during sitting, standing, walking through a narrow corridor, walking with self-initiated stops and dual-task walking, after overnight withdrawal of dopaminergic medication and with stimulation OFF. Signals include bipolar subthalamic local field potentials, 48-channel scalp EEG with surface EMG, and inertial sensor kinematics, supporting investigation of supraspinal mechanisms of freezing of gait.
methods_description: Bipolar STN local field potentials were streamed from the Medtronic Percept (BrainSense, 250 Hz). Scalp EEG (48 channels) with 8 surface EMG channels and 2 IPG channels was recorded with Brain Products amplifiers at 1000 Hz. Three APDM Opal inertial sensors (lumbar spine and both legs/feet) recorded at 128 Hz. Participants performed sitting, standing, corridor walking, walking with stops and dual-task (serial subtraction) walking at University Hospital Tübingen.
